optional mod.

## Review checks

- [ ] Original-game source changes retain a complete-executable match.
- [ ] Coverage and behavior claims describe only the evidence actually collected.
- [ ] No game binaries, disc images, BIOS, extracted assets or private evidence are included.
- [ ] Attribution and existing third-party notices are preserved.
